featured_reviews.review_text:
The south Indian food here is a must have if you're visiting this place. So this was my go to spot for all the times I've gone for cycling to Versova beach. The best part about this restaurant is that it opens up really early in the morning so fortunately I can have a wholesome breakfast and continue with my cycling. I've tried their Medu Vada, idli, sabudana Vada, neer dosa, onion rava dosa and I've loved all of them except for the sabudana Vada which wasn't cooked well from inside. But overall a really good place to try out.

Edit: 11-Oct-2024
my recent visit to this hotel has made me change my mind, especially when the staff picked up the rasgolas that were fallen on the floor and packed them back in the containers that would be sent to the customers.

I seen them coating the rasgulas with the special floor coat and then packing them in lovely boxes.

made me wonder, may be that's where the rasgolas got their shine from and also maybe the taste as it was a more earthly flavour and boot smelling taste.

I had ordered my regular medu wada sambar and lassi, but after looking at the hygiene that they displayed, made me wonder what was in my food???

featured_reviews.name: Rahil Kotadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this place and had a mixed experience overall. The food quality was quite inconsistent. While some items were good, others were disappointing. The paneer dishes were a letdown — the paneer was hard, chewy, and lacked flavor, which affected the overall taste of the dish.

We also unfortunately found a hair in one of the dishes. When we informed the staff, no one from the management came to address the issue or even offer an apology, which was quite disappointing. The service overall was very poor and inattentive, making the experience worse.

The ambience is decent but nothing exceptional. Another issue was the air conditioning — some parts of the restaurant felt too cold while others were warm and uncomfortable, making the seating experience uneven.

On the positive side, the soups were flavorful and worth trying. Their Mughlai main courses were well-prepared and enjoyable, and the chaat items were also tasty and nicely done.

Overall, the place has potential because some dishes are genuinely good, but improvements in service, consistency, and basic hospitality standards are definitely needed.

We sat downstairs, where the ambience was calm, cozy, and not too noisy perfect for a relaxed meal. We started with the bell pepper and tofu bruschetta, which was flavorful and light. But the real star of the meal was the beet and tofu ravioli in aglio e olio sauce. It was incredibly rich, delicious, and honestly one of the best ravioli dishes I’ve ever had.
Thank God is definitely a must-visit for anyone looking for something healthy yet indulgent in Versova. I’m already looking forward to going back, and I highly recommend everyone to try that ravioli it’s absolutely worth it!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Radha Krishna Veg Restaurant is a great spot for simple, comforting Maharashtrian food. We ordered misal pav, batata vada, and puri bhaji, and everything was fresh, tasty, and well prepared. The misal had a good balance of spice, the batata vada was crisp, and the puri bhaji was satisfying and filling. The total bill came to around ₹800, which felt reasonable for the quantity and quality.

The ambience is simple and clean, with a calm, no-frills setup that suits a traditional vegetarian restaurant. It has a homely, comfortable feel, making it ideal for families and casual dining. The seating is basic but well maintained, and the overall atmosphere is peaceful and welcoming, letting the food remain the main highlight.

Overall, a good place for a wholesome vegetarian meal.

featured_reviews.name: Sunil Wadhwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Will surely rate this as 4.5 and above.
First of all Salutations to Shri Pravin Shetty and many thanks to Shri Sudesh Rai as well. Our Wadhwani family have been regular visitors here, ever since our children joined H.M.P.School in 2000-2001. We visited here for lunch today after a long gap of nearly 7/8 years. Pleasantly inviting as always, the management is constantly involved in seating the customers, guiding the stewards and waiters to unattended tables, especially during rush hours, thereby raising the standards of hospitality to a new high.
They have both AC (higher prices) and non-AC sections. Waiting time for AC usually is 15 minutes or more, unless you reach early by 12.15 or 12.30 pm for lunch. We chose the non-AC with good overhead fans, since we were hungry and it was nearly 2 pm.
A heartfelt thanks to Sanjay and his colleagues for the impeccable service provided today and attention to detail.
We had a mix of Cheese Pav Bhaji, Puri Bhaji, Benne Masala Dosa, Rava Masala Dosa and Mysore Masala Dosa with a side order of Sweet Lassi for all.
Each item was served hot, with the regular accompaniments, onion, lime, specially requested pickle, hot sambhar and coconut chutney.
They serve cold Distilled water in Stainless steel glasses, which bypasses the need for any bottled mineral water.
Good quality tissues and an easily accessible washbasin make it convenient for clean up after a finger licking, palate tickling vegetarian meal. Being 100% vegetarian is the added advantage here. They accept all kinds of payments with no extra surcharge or service charges. The regulatory 5% GST is added to your bill amount.
A good hearty meal for five cost us less than 1500 including tips.
Even if you are very hungry and are good eaters, surely you won't spend more than 400-450 per person at this absolutely genuine vegetarian restaurant catering mostly to the College and school kids, especially during day time and the locals living in Andheri West, especially in the evenings.
Valet parking is available.
Latest menu shared here. A separate Fire of Mexico menu, includes Starters, Main course, salads, pasta n rice available . Speciality juices and milkshakes too.

They also provide Home Delivery albeit at slightly higher prices than in-house eating.  Home delivery menu also attached here.

Do visit with peace of mind. Be calm and relaxed. Being hypertensive creates a foul atmosphere for yourselves. Enjoy and return smiling.

featured_reviews.name: Swapnil Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text: A masterclass in texture and spice, the Chole Samosa Chaat here is a sensory riot where the shattered, golden crunch of the samosa is beautifully surrendered to a deep, tangy chickpea curry, all elevated by a cooling drizzle of yogurt and the electric snap of fresh chutneys. To recreate this at home, simmer boiled chickpeas in a masala of onions, ginger-garlic, and amchoor, then ladle it over crushed hot samosas and finish with a snowfall of fine sev and chopped onions. In a sophisticated contrast, the Rava Dosa arrives as a shatteringly crisp, lacy veil of gold; its secret lies in a buttermilk-thin batter of semolina, rice flour, and cumin poured from a height onto a screaming-hot griddle until it develops its signature "Swiss-cheese" holes. Whether you’re diving into the indulgent, street-style chaos of the chaat or the ethereal, buttery crispness of the dosa, this is a dual-course experience that perfectly celebrates the diverse landscape of Indian soul food.

featured_reviews.name: Jatin Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located at ground level of the Empressa Hotel, Andheri West, would say this would be a great place to spend your evening catching up with friends. However since the place is open it can warm especially during the day. We went there for lunch, though there are coolers placed everywhere. The ambience is nice and vibrant. They served modern indian continental, Italian and Mexican dishes.

We tried the following dishes -

Firstly was Khopoli Croquettas - nice fusion of Vada Pav in form of fried croquettes served along with mint chutney. Next we tried the Corn Cheddar Fritters. As name suggests corn fritters stuffed with cheddar cheese served along with jalapeno sour cream. Moving to mains, we called for the Farmer's Pizza topped with mushrooms, corn, onions, bell pepper, etc. Pizzas are thin crust!

All in all a decent experience at Loco Loca. As mentioned earlier, great to visit in evenings, especially with lights on. Do pay a visit!

featured_reviews.name: GLEN MONTEIRO
featured_reviews.review_text:
Loco Loca is a cordial, lively place located on the ground floor of The Empresa Hotel. The ambiance of this place is characterized by its open air kitchen and it's enticing canopy. The Spanish and Italian folk music playing in the background incites feelings of cravings and euphoria. The place is embellished with an amazing set up in the dining area with spacious seating. On top of that, the dessert bar with an amazing line up of sweet treats and confectionery adds to the charm.

The bistro makes you feel in your element with their camaraderie. The atmosphere of this place and the crew connive to make the customer feel like a huésped as they embrace them to their ménage.

The service was pretty good. Our table was hosted by Mr. Rahul, Mr. Nikhil and Mr. Vishal. They helped us out in selecting the dishes and were very friendly. The restaurant being an part of The Empresa, has to manage the hotel guests along with the adventurous diners who visit the place. So it may take a while to get what you order but the food is totally worth the wait.

They serve a variety of dishes from the Mediterranean and North Indian Cuisine. The menu is pretty elaborate and covers a lot of palatable dishes with top class presentation. The chefs collude to serve appetizing and innovative dishes to appease the diners and bring a smile of satisfaction on their faces.

Our table was festooned with salads, burgers, appetizers, risotto and desserts.
We started off with 'Feta & Co. '. It's a salad constructed with the Greek Feta and a combination of fresh fruits and mixed greens. The salty and tangy taste of Feta combined with the flavours of fresh fruits and avocado makes it one of the finest salads in the menu.

The 'Supreme Crisp Burger' had the perfect cohesiveness between the amount of bun, meat and toppings. It was a merger of the chicken supreme patty, onion rings with the side of potato wedges. The bun was nicely toasted to hold up the patty. The quality of the meat used was top class which made the burger very juicy.
We also had 'Easy green Burger' which was served with a side of potato wedges and salads. It had a delectable taste.

Mediterranean food is more than just pizza and spaghetti, for a change, we ordered 'Grilled Portobello & Asparagus Risotto'. It was ambrosial! Amazing taste. The 'Potato Mille-Feuille' was very appetizing. The combination of fried potatoes and wild mushrooms with parmesan ragoût made it delicious!

We had a few beverages here: 'Passion Fruit Chilli Lemonade' and 'Blueberry & Basil lemonade'. They were very refreshing. The passion fruit chilli tasted really good. It had a spicy twist to it.

They serve some of the most bewitching and delicious desserts. We had 'Hazelnut Mousse' and 'Chocolate Chip Cupcake'. The Hazelnut mousse is one the best desserts I've had in a while. It tasted heavenly with a the base made of chocolate crumbs. The cup cake tasted alright. I liked the Mousse more.

Mediterranean food is one of those cultural elements that have felicitously helped to preserve the special nature of the Mediterranean.
When it comes to Mediterranean Cuine, Loco loca is definitely one of the best places in town.

featured_reviews.name: Indradeep Roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
An open air restaurant located inside the premises of Empress hotel just in front of the entrance gate. Valet is available in the hotel premises.

The price of food and beverages are normal. The entire restaurant has been decorated with a green architecture with a wall dedicated to plants and creepers. A perfect place to take picture.

A giant screen is available in the middle of the restaurant and thus can be a great place during top sporting events.

The waiters are very polite and helpful. However they need to be bit more attentive as finding them at times was difficult as they were not making eye contacts

Tried their peri peri chicken that was above average. In the main course I tried grilled chicken and mushroom sizzlers served with rice made in Oriental style. It was indeed very tasty. In Sizzlers they have options to make it in Oriental or Mediterranean style. In Oriental it’s severed with rice while in Oriental Spaghetti is used.  The patron can also choose between French fries or potato wedges or mashed potatoes as the side.

I went in here reading it’s a Spanish place although it turned out to be different. Overall I believe a great place to hang out with friends at a budgeted price

What did disappoint us though was the sizzler menu. Cream Centre is quite popular for its sizzlers, and we were really looking forward to trying them. Unfortunately, out of eight options, only two were available at the time, which was a bit of a letdown.

As for the ambience and service(thanks to Gayatri), both were just okay—nothing to complain about, but nothing particularly memorable either.

Overall, a decent place for vegetarian food, but it didn’t quite match the expectations we had going in.

featured_reviews.name: Noor Sayeed Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Madras Diaries in Bandra has such a gorgeous, welcoming vibe, it’s easily one of the prettiest spots for South Indian food in the city. The staff was genuinely sweet and the service was so smooth it made the whole experience feel really relaxed.

We decided to try their new chaat menu, and the Shakkarkand Matar ki Chaat was a total winner, it felt super fresh and not at all oily. The Chatpata Singhada (water chestnut) was a fun surprise too, especially for that unique crunch you don't usually find in street food.

The Madras Diaries Special Combo is a solid choice if you’re like me and can't decide the medu vada was perfectly crispy. But honestly, the real highlight was the Filter Coffee with those Rawa Biscuits. It’s such a nostalgic, comforting pairing. We finished with the Elaneer Payasum, which was light and refreshing, though I wish there was just a bit more of it! Definitely worth a visit if you’re in Bandra and want a meal that feels both clean and satisfying.

featured_reviews.name: Allen Samuel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Madras Diaries is a perfect blend of authentic South Indian comfort and exciting new flavours! The highlight now is their chaat menu, which adds a fun, chatpata twist alongside their classic offerings.

The Chatpata Singhada and Shakkarkand Matar Ki Chaat were vibrant, tangy, and full of flavour. The Chettinad Paneer with flaky wheat parotta was rich and satisfying, paired beautifully with the soft Kodumai (wheat) parotta. Refreshing sips like the Cold Coffee and Virgin Mojito balanced the meal, while the Elaneer Payasam was a light, delicious finish.

The presentation of each dish was impressive and clearly made with attention to detail. Service was warm and prompt, making the overall experience even more enjoyable.

With its warm décor and relaxed, inviting ambience, Madras Diaries is a must-visit for a wholesome meal with a unique chaat twist!

featured_reviews.name: Aaniket R Naddkarni
featured_reviews.review_text:
VARUGA VARUGA ❤️

Everyone is craving South Indian food these days… looks like Idli & Dosa have officially become Gen Z’s favorite comfort food 😍
So we decided to check out Madras Diaries in Bandra — a place already famous for authentic South Indian food, but now they’ve also launched CHATS… and trust me, this will make you visit again & again!

Without wasting any time, we started with our favorite — Pani Puri 🤤
And bhai sahab… they served it with 3 different flavor waters — Mumbai style, Delhiwala & Kolkata style!
We literally couldn’t stop eating 😅

Then came the Palak Patta Chaat…
And bhai, ekdum Delhi ki yaad dila di ❤️

To beat the summer heat, we tried their Kokum Cooler & Mint Cooler — super refreshing and fresh!

For mains, we ordered Mini Idlies served with 4 different chutneys… and trust me, this combo is something you’ll only get here, so make sure it’s on your order list ✔️

We also tried the Malabar Paratha with Chettinad Paneer — great quantity, rich flavors, and the paneer was super soft 😍

And finally in desserts, Pineapple Sheera… simple, comforting, and honestly made with love ❤️
So make sure you visit Madras Diaries

featured_reviews.review_text: I thoroughly enjoyed the Mysore Masala Dosa, Idli Vada, Mini Idli, Pineapple Sheera, and Filter Coffee. Every item was delightful. Food took a while to be served, but it was fine for us. Highly recommended.

Chocolate Smoothie: Mind-blown that this is sugar-free! It was rich and perfectly sweet; you’d never guess it was the healthier choice.

Spiced Grilled Chicken Breast: Hand down the best chicken breast I’ve ever had. Super juicy and perfectly cooked. The "Hum green paste" on top is a game changer.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Found it overrated. Was looking forward to the farm to table concept. We ordered 3 sandwiches - Prawn Ghee Roast, Korean Chicken & Broc n Roll. We also ordered 3 mango milkshakes. Service was non existent. No water served. We ordered our food at the counter which is ok. Sandwiches took 30+ minutes. We asked for menu several times but were given one after we had finished eating. This took away anything else that we would have ordered since we didnt have menus.

Coming to the food. The Sour Dough used for the sandwiches was just too chewy. Our jaws started hurting (no exaggeration) trying to finish them. We were in no mood to complain as we were already late and noone in the restaurant seemed bothered about it anyway. The Korean chicken sandwich tasted off. The flavours didnt go well with the sour dough. Should have been in a milk bun. The fries were excellent! The milk shake again was just ok. Nothing special.

The meal felt very expensive (I know its Bandra) for the over quality of food.

Hope they get better.

Visited Pind by Pratap for their famous Chole Bhature, and overall it was a good experience. The chole was flavorful, well-balanced, and pleasantly non-spicy, making it enjoyable without being overwhelming. However, I felt that side of pickle provided was needed to bring out the complete flavor profile and add that extra punch.

The bhaturas were nicely made, but the quantity of chole served wasn't quite enough for the two bhaturas provided. We ended up ordering an extra bowl of chole, and were surprised to find that it cost well over 50% of the price of the full plate despite being roughly the same quantity of chole. That felt a bit overpriced.

We also tried the aloo kulcha. The kulcha itself was excellent and could easily have been one of the best I've had, if not for the excessive coriander seeds sprinkled on top. The tangy chutney served alongside it was absolutely the highlight and complemented the dish beautifully.

The staff was friendly and attentive, and the ambience was decent and comfortable. While there are a few areas that could be improved, the food quality was decent.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Greetings from Pind by Prataps!

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We sincerely apologize that your experience did not meet expectations. Your comments have been noted and shared with our team as we continuously work towards improving our food and service.

We truly value your feedback and hope to have the opportunity to serve you again and provide a much better experience.

Regards,
Team Pind by Prataps

featured_reviews.name: Anshita Saxena
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited Pind By Pratap’s and honestly, this place is a paradise for chaat & Punjabi food lovers 😍✨
It’s a newly opened pure veg restaurant with vibrant ambience, quick service and a menu full of North Indian favourites. We started with their refreshing welcome shots and crispy golgappas which instantly set the mood right 🌶️🥤
Tried multiple chaats including Nachos Corn Chaat, Dahi Bhalla and Aloo Tikki Chaat — and the Aloo Tikki Chaat was definitely the star for me ❤️ The flavours were perfectly balanced and super chatpate.
Their Chole Bhature were soft, fluffy and served piping hot 🤤 But the real surprise was the Agra Kachori and Matar Kulche — very authentic and full of flavour.
We also tried the Amritsari Kulcha on the staff’s recommendation and it turned out to be absolutely delicious 🔥
To end the meal on a sweet note, Gulab Jamun and Phirni were just perfect ✨
Overall, a great spot in Andheri West for pure veg Punjabi food, chaats and family dining. Definitely worth visiting! 🙌
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your wonderful 5-star review! We’re thrilled you loved the authentic Punjabi flavours, chaats, ambience, and overall dining experience — looking forward to welcoming you again soon for many more delicious moments.

featured_reviews.name: VlogWithFurkan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited Pind by Pratap’s in Andheri West and it was truly a delightful experience! ✨ This place is started by the founders of Pratap’s The Dhaba, and you can clearly see their legacy in the quality and taste of food.
What I loved the most was the warm welcome with complimentary welcome shots, which instantly set the mood right. The restaurant is completely pure veg, but the flavours are so rich and satisfying that even non-veg lovers will enjoy every bite.
We started with Aalo Tikki Chaat, Bhalla Papdi Chaat, and Nacho Corn Chaat — all three were perfectly balanced with the right mix of sweet, tangy, and spicy flavours. The crunch, freshness, and presentation were on point.
For the main course, we tried the Chole Bhature and Amritsari Kulcha with chhole. Honestly, this was the highlight! The kulcha was buttery, well-stuffed, and cooked to perfection, while the chhole were spicy, flavourful, and gave that authentic Delhi street food vibe. We also had the Matar Butter Kulcha, which was soft, rich, and super satisfying.
Coming to the beverages, the Aam Panna, Kesar Dudh, and Lassi were refreshing and paired really well with the food.
To end on a sweet note, we had Firni — light, creamy, and the perfect dessert to complete the meal.
Overall, Pind by Pratap’s serves amazing North Indian and Delhi-style street food in a pocket-friendly range. The taste, quality, and experience make it a must-visit spot in Andheri West for all food lovers.
Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Tanishka Rajpal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Pind By Prataps recently in Andheri West and honestly had a great experience. The place serves proper Delhi-style street food and the flavours are really on point. We tried the Amritsari kulcha, chole bhature, aloo tikki and dahi bhalla — everything was fresh, chatpata and full of taste.

They even start with complimentary shots which was a nice touch. The lassi and aam panna were super refreshing, and the phirni was a perfect way to end the meal.

It’s a pure veg place, pocket-friendly and perfect if you’re craving North Indian street food in Mumbai. Definitely worth visiting 👍

featured_reviews.name: A D
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had lunch at The Village Shop today with my husband and overall it was a good experience. The food was fresh, wholesome, and it’s definitely a great place for people with allergies, dietary restrictions, or specific food preferences.

There was one mix-up where potato was added instead of sweet potato mash in one of the dishes, but the team replaced it with exotic vegetables without any issue, which we appreciated.

The only area that could really improve is the service and ingredient awareness among the staff. Our waiter didn’t seem very well informed about the ingredients and communication could have been better, especially for a place that caters to special diets and allergies. He was also taking the order from behind the counter instead of coming to the table, which felt a little impersonal.

That said, it’s still a lovely place with great potential, and this feedback is only to help make the experience even better with more informed and attentive staff.

featured_reviews.name: Roche Mascarenhas
featured_reviews.review_text:
Firstly! It’s a bit inside so you might not find it easily! But the space is cute cozy and really nice! It’s a pet friendly space so you can take your pets there!

Oh and yea! Their mushroom burger too was amazing.
Incase you’re with a big group you might have to reserve the space!

featured_reviews.name: Neeraja Sundar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very ghastly and amusing experience at the Village Shop. I spent a Monday morning here, was hoping to get my coffee and breakfast  in some peace and quiet. It was only me in the cafe and the owner with 2 of her staff on another table.
In the first 10 mins I figured the owner had issues with staff, even though they spoke in hushed tones.

I let it slide. Naturally, I have no context of that conversation.
The food wasn’t up to the mark. They had it replaced without getting defensive.

Then, after a few mins I spoke loudly because I was on a call, and there was no one else in the cafe but me and the owner, I was asked to speak softly. She was irked. I gladly obliged.

I stepped outside to take my call. For 45 mins. In the heat. You see, I have been brought up with a lot of empathy.
It felt like my grandmother gave me a punishment to not enter the house.

What a ghastly experience for a Bandra cafe.  I hope the owners have the business acumen to start something else of their own. Customer centricity and empathy are not the strongest suit of some of the most affluent people in Bandra. What tarnishes reputation is lack of empathy for staff and no understanding of what customer focus looks like.

Money can’t buy you manners or class.

Its evident to me today, yet again :)

The put up nice decoration of flowers which was something different, its bit expensive but i believe it is okay for the ambience they provide.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this place for lunch on Tuesday with my family, consisting of 12 people we got the table  in just 5 minutes. After we settled in, we placed our orders which included 1 rice Idli sambar, 1 puri bhaji, 1 Rajani dosa, a Benne Podi sada dosa, 2 podi mini Idlis, stew with appam, Malabar curry with appam, Aviyal with appam, Chettinadu with paratha, neer dosa, and more.

**Recommendation** -
The Benne Podi sada dosa is highly recommended.
The podi mini idli was also exceptionally delicious.

**Must try** -
The Malabar curry with appam or neer dosa.
The stew with appam is also a must-try.

Valet parking is available at this location.
The flavors were incredibly delicious and authentic.
The service was remarkably quick, and I appreciated the hospitality offered at this venue.

featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited Banana Leaf, located at Ground Floor, Shubham CHS, Juhu Versova Link Road, Four Bungalows, Andheri West — and the experience was absolutely fantastic!

The ambience is beautifully inspired by South Indian themes, with both indoor and outdoor dining spaces. It’s the perfect spot for South Indian food lovers, and no surprise — it stays packed not only on weekends but even on weekdays.

They’ve introduced a brand-new Podi Festival menu, and it’s truly something special. Their new Kadipatta Podi, mixed with generous ghee and flavour, is a must-try!
Here’s what we ordered:
•	Tava Neer Dosa
•	South Canara Masala Dosa
•	Pacche Podi Rice
•	Ragi Semiya Upma
•	Mallige Set Green Podi Masala
•	Multigrain Onion Ada Dosa
•	Green Ghee Podi Mini Idli
•	Pacche Benne Masala Dosa

Every dish was fresh, flavourful, and perfectly prepared.
We also tried their Filter Coffee, which was refreshing and completed the meal beautifully.

The service was top-notch — the staff, manager, and overall hospitality made the experience even better.

Overall: 10/10 experience.
This new Podi Festival menu is available across all Banana Leaf outlets in Mumbai, so visit your nearest one if you love authentic South Indian cuisine, especially their dosas and idlis.

Highly recommended! 🌿✨

featured_reviews.name: Ritu Bhatt
featured_reviews.review_text: All idli items are very tasty & worth the high price. But the dosa & uttapam items aren't tasty. It's not as good as the value of money. Plus nothing special or delicious.. Didn't like the stuffing inside benne masala. It was only white potato stuffing..and overall bland. It was also very noisy, the service was slow but waiters would come back with what was asked from them, so that part was good.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Prasad Kamble
featured_reviews.review_text:
Banana Leaf is a great place for anyone who loves authentic vegetarian South Indian food. We tried a few of their delicacies—filter coffee, appam, and the Benne Podi Masala Dosa.
My absolute favorite was the Benne Podi Masala Dosa. It’s not like the traditional benne dosa that comes drenched in coconut oil—this version is neat, easy to eat, and definitely feels healthier. It’s served with white butter (makkhan), flavorful chutney, and sambar, which perfectly balance the dosa.
The filter coffee was comforting and well brewed, and the appam was soft and light. They have a wide range of South Indian delicacies on the menu, and there’s a lot more I’m looking forward to trying.
I’ll definitely keep updating my reviews as and when we visit again. For now, the Benne Podi Masala Dosa is completely on my mind and a must-try! 😋

featured_reviews.name: Ashok Sankaran
featured_reviews.review_text: This tiny cafe on Waterfield Road is perfect for dinner with you and your family. The cozy setting, featuring pale green and pink decorations, gives you that perfect peaceful atmosphere. Earth Cafe offers a variety of options whether you’re vegetarian, Jain or just wanting something different. The food is high quality with something for everyone. The avocado bruschetta has the perfect amount of crispness and flavour. The fries are freshly made, perfect for a crunchy starter. The peach and mint mojito is to die for. To choose a main dish is nearly impossible. From freshly baked sourdough pizzas or piping hot risotto. The lasagna is an amazing dish with layered zucchini and a creamy vegan sauce. If you’re not already stuffed and want a sweet treat, they have a variety of cakes to choose from including some gluten free options. But the perfect treat for summer is the mango and cream. The service was exceptional and the staff were super helpful. Overall an amazing place to dine out. Rahul who served us during our visit was great.

featured_reviews.name: larissa jones
featured_reviews.review_text: Earth Café is a wonderful place with very high-quality food and plenty of healthy options to choose from. The service was attentive and extremely friendly, which made the experience even better. As their first customer of the day, we were kindly offered a free slice of cake — it was rich, delicious, and such a lovely surprise. The café itself has a beautiful design and a very welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommended the masala tea, tofu scrambled egg and masala tea, and we’ll definitely be back!

featured_reviews.name: Taronish Khambata
featured_reviews.review_text:
Earth Cafe, at Waterfield Road, Bandra (W), is one of the most hospitable cafes I've ever had the pleasure of being at.

It has a cozy, warm atmosphere that instantly makes you feel at ease and comfort. I had the pleasure to be serviced by Ketan for food & beverages. He's kind, warm, hospitable, and ensures your needs are met.

Food here is clean, healthy, and delicious. I definitely recommend one pot rice & carrot walnut cake. They are delicious!

They also a free detox water counter for you to indulge in. Worth it!

Overall, I highly recommend you to visit this cafe, if you've never ever been to.

PS: They gave me this amazing chocolate pastry as a token of being an amazing guest. How sweet 🤍

featured_reviews.name: Robocu Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Beautiful, fantastic experience,  the staff and the owner were super warm.

We organized a Meet-Up there and the team was very cooperative.

Soothing interiors, vegan food and good atmosphere.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We’re grateful for your support and kind words. It means a lot to us and to our team members who work hard to create a great experience for every guest.

featured_reviews.review_text: Such a beautiful quaint place and so many vegan and veg options. Also gluten free friendly. I really enjoyed the Jack jack - which is a sweet potato dish and the carrot walnut cake which was a tad bit dry but still delicious. The coffee’s we ordered were also nice. We had Ketan help us today and he is super friendly and super attentive. He checked in on us and gave us special attention. We will definitely be coming here again.

We’re glad you enjoyed the variety of vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options, as well as the Jack Jack dish and carrot walnut cake. We appreciate your honest note about the cake and are happy to hear you still enjoyed it along with the coffee. We’ll be sure to pass on your kind words to Ketan for his friendly and attentive service. We truly appreciate your feedback and look forward to welcoming you back to Earth Café again soon.

name: Golden Chariot
description: Embark on a culinary adventure at Golden Chariot, a vibrant restaurant offering a diverse panorama of Asian flavors. From fiery North Indian curries to delicate Chinese stir-fries, succulent Mughlai specialties to classic Italian pizzas, Golden Chariot caters to every craving. Indulge in decadent desserts and refreshing beverages to complete your exploration of Asian delights. Whether you seek a casual dining experience, a lively bar setting, or a takeaway feast, Golden Chariot promises an unforgettable journey through the rich tapestry of Asian cuisine.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently had the pleasure of dining at Golden Chariot, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience. From the moment we walked in, the service was impeccable. The staff was attentive, friendly, and went above and beyond to ensure our comfort.

Now, let's talk about the food. We indulged in a delightful array of dishes, each bursting with flavor. The Aloo Paratha was cooked to perfection, and the Khichiya Masala Papad added a delicious crunch to the meal. The Veg Cheese Pizza was a cheesy delight, and the Green Salad was fresh and vibrant.

One standout dish was the Sugar Cane with Passion Fruit—refreshing and unique, it was a true culinary delight. And let's not forget the Green Chutney, which was simply out of this world, along with the zesty Schezwan sauce that added a perfect kick to the meal.

Overall, I highly recommend Golden Chariot for its tasty food and excellent service. Whether you're craving traditional Indian dishes or something more adventurous, this hotel delivers on all fronts.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Davda
featured_reviews.review_text:
GC is a Pure Veg resturant opposite andheri shoppers stop. GC was very helpful to arrange a table for 14 which included 10 adults & 4 kids on Saturday night ( 21.4.18 ) on very short notice whereas most places were either packed or couldn’t arrange seating for tis number .

Must Have from our order :-
Manchow Soup, Dry Manchurian, Dry Paneer chilly Veg Mastana, Rotis over Kulcha , Malai kulfi .

Our extensive order was as follows :-
Soup
1) Tomato Soup - Kids
2) Sweet Corn Soup - kids
3) Hot N Sour Soup - Very Nice
4) Manchow Soup - Super . Best among the lot
5) Cream of Veg - Decent

Starters
1) Dry Manchurian :- Superb
2) Paneer Chilly :- paneer was soft & sauces were spicy as per our request .
3) Spring Roll :- Average . Compared to the other two tis dish was a let down .

Main Course :-
Indian
1) Veg Mastana :- Tis Veg was amazing .
2) Daal Makhani ( Black Daal ) :- Was bland & a let down.
3) butter tandoori Roti turned out better than the kulcha .
4) Masala Papad :- Decent
Chinese Main course
1) Veg Hakka Noodles :- Mainly for the kids as a non spicy option but for adults it was quite bland
2) Triple Schezwan Rice :- Wasn’t spicy enough but overall a decent item

Desserts :-
1) Falooda :- quality & quantity decent but quite sweet for my liking .
2) Malai Kulfi :- sweetness was balanced & enjoyed tis more than the Falooda

Overall Review :-
Location :- Very Nice & easily accessible
Valet parking available which is a huge relief otherwise you would have to park around or in shoppers stop especially during weekends.
Ambience :- Simple & Decent ( nothing fancy )
Staff :- Very Polite & cooperative
( Our Table Supervisor & Server were very helpful in food selection  & dint create a fuss about the noise made by us ) - Added his pic 👍
Service :- Average wasn’t fast but neither too slow
Food Quality :- Decent
Food Quantity :- Very Good
Food Taste :- Soup & starters were very nice .
Main course go for Indian over Chinese .

VFM :- 4/5 . Our soup & starters turned out better than our main course.
